subject: Re: Trial demo intake — dayparts, concurrency profile, and PST-friendly slots
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@greenify.co>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: sara@greenify.co
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood trial + quick demo

Hi Vivek,

I signed up earlier this week and am evaluating Redwood for a customer-facing chat feature we’re launching in Q4. High level: real-time generation (assistant-style), a search fallback with embeddings for context, and strict PII controls.

We’re early but expect production ramp to ~300 req/s (steady) with short peaks up to ~1k req/s during campaigns. Typical prompt size is ~70 tokens, responses ~160 tokens. Timeline: want a POC in July and a pilot by Aug.

Can we do a short demo next week to see latency/throughput and confirm sandbox access? Morning PST works best for our team. I can attach a quick traffic export if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product, Greenify
alex@greenify.co
(attachment: traffic_snapshot.csv)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@greenify.co>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood trial + quick demo

Alex — thanks for the sign-up and the context, this is helpful. A few quick qualification checks before we lock a time so the demo is focused: 

- Primary workload: generation with embedding fallback (confirmed)? Any batch embedding jobs or pure indexing jobs we should know about?
- Concurrency breakdown: you’ve given steady/peak, can you confirm how many concurrent users translate to that 300 req/s (i.e., avg requests per user / minute)?
- SSO / SAML needs for sandbox or later pilot? Are you evaluating Hosted API or want a Dedicated lane?
- Data residency / retention constraints (EU customers or only US)?
- Do you need streaming responses or function calls in the demo?

If you can attach the traffic_snapshot.csv that’d be ideal. Proposed 30–40 minute slots (all PST):
1) Tue Jul 8 — 9:30–10:10am
2) Wed Jul 9 — 8:00–8:40am
3) Thu Jul 10 — 11:00–11:40am

Here’s a quick calendar link to book: https://cal.example.com/vivek/slots

Ben (cc’d) will join to cover throughput and sandbox access. We can also include Monica if you want a short SSO/security primer.

—Vivek
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
(attachment reference: poc_scope.docx)

From: Alex Morgan <alex@greenify.co>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Thomas <sara@greenify.co>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 13:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood trial + quick demo

Vivek —

Thanks for the questions. Answers inline: 
- Yes, primary is generation with embeddings as fallback for context. We also run nightly batch indexing (~10M docs) but not latency-sensitive.
- 300 req/s maps to ~75 concurrent active users (avg 4 requests per user over 60s). Peaks hit when a campaign triggers (~1k req/s for ~10 minutes).
- We require SSO (SAML) for the sandbox and will likely need Private/Dedicated for pilot due to PCI scope.
- Data residency: primarily US but we have a subset of EU users; for pilot we need EU routing options.
- Streaming: yes, preferred for chat UX. Function calling not required for the POC.

Attached the traffic_snapshot.csv. We’d like Wed Jul 9 at 8:00am PST (slot 2).

Alex
Head of Product, Greenify
alex@greenify.co
(attachment: traffic_snapshot.csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@greenify.co>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood trial + quick demo

Alex — great, Wed Jul 9 8:00am PST is confirmed. I’ll send a calendar invite in a minute; meeting will be 35 minutes. Agenda: quick intro (5m), traffic & SSO requirements (10m), live demo focusing on latency/throughput (15m), next steps & sandbox delivery (5m).

Monica, please have a brief SSO checklist ready (SAML metadata we’ll need) and a note on EU routing options.

Couple of follow-ups for you before the call so we can prep the environment:
- Which OpenID provider do you use for SSO (Okta, Azure AD, other)?
- Can you confirm the largest prompt+response token estimate (you mentioned 230 tokens total)?
- Any nonce IP allowlist we should pre-configure for sandbox?

Invite on its way. Looking forward — Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(attachment: none)
